official_findings.finding: Current government collection page was last updated 24 March 2026 and describes the Environment Agency 1m DTM plus 5km National Grid GeoTIFF download role.

official_findings.source: Survey Index OGC API Features landing
official_findings.finding: Official Features service exposes machine-processable API, collections and conformance resources.
Relevant collections are explicitly named LIDAR_Composite_1m_DTM_2022_extents, LIDAR_DTM_Time_Stamped_Extents and National_LIDAR_Programme_Index_Catalogue; storage CRS is EPSG:27700.
Real lineage fields include flight start/end, resolution, transform, geoid, latest, dtm_name and ostilename; ostilename granularity is not inferred from the three 5km target hints.
Real National LIDAR lineage fields include tilename, dtm_fn, flight dates, surveys, season, resolution, year, supplied and latest.
Official Time Stamped DTM polygon layer is EPSG:27700 and exposes filename, os_ref, flight dates, transform, geoid, filepath, latest and polygon_id with JSON/GeoJSON/PBF query support.
